paper_title: A Universal Bound on QCD Axions from Supernovae
notes: Model-independent bound on the QCD axion from SN1987A cooling via a newly identified tree-level axion production channel from the shift-symmetry-breaking nEDM operator. Headline result Eq.(14)/(16): f_a > 1.1(+0.4/-0.6)e8 GeV (68% C.L.), equivalently m_a < 5.3e-2 eV. Reported in the canonical AxionMass plane as 1/f_a = 1/(1.1e8 GeV) = 9.0909e-9 GeV^-1. The bound is a flat horizontal exclusion (excluded region above the line, 1/f_a > 9.09e-9) drawn across the full mass axis in Fig.5 ('This work' red band, ~1e-20 to 1e1 eV), since the constraint is model-independent in f_a. CL is 68% (not 90/95) as stated in the paper. Bound does not depend on DM density (SN cooling), so dm_density_assumed is null.
